issues.detail: The recorded D0 bytes compare the old word against unsigned 0xffffffff before incrementing. The candidate correctly stores 1 while returning all 32 original EAX bits, 0xffffffff, for that sentinel; old 0xfffffffe stores and returns 0xffffffff.

The recorded D4/D8 bytes increment before testing the result. Both implementations correctly map old 0xfffffffe to stored/returned 1 and old 0xffffffff to stored/returned 0. uint32_t arithmetic preserves defined modulo-2^32 behavior.

Each function completes one little-endian four-byte read before its four-byte write, at the contracted offset only. GuestMemory uses byte access without alignment or typed-pointer alias assumptions; shifts are bounded to 0, 8, 16 and 24. Object offsets 0..128 keep every access within the arena. Overlapping guest views retain the same affected bytes; surrounding bytes remain untouched.

Module SHA-256, RVAs and complete slice hashes establish the three recorded identities; LLVM symbol labels do not establish original names. Supplied verified bindings connect the reviewed source hash to the frozen contracts, reference and executed reports. Build, both synthetic commands, 340 public and 128 heldout cases per function passed; the compiled D0 return mutant produced five mismatches. Raw-file and canonical-JSON digest domains are appropriately distinguished.

limitations: Approval covers only src/object_counters.cpp with raw SHA-256 55b74b818c63d012ca5632770fb2b8168d12ba5b075152964be1768ba91a6942 under the frozen bounded contracts; it does not approve registry integration.
Original execution used Unicorn 2.1.4 on macOS ARM64; candidate execution used AppleClang 21 C++20 ARM64 RelWithDebInfo. No native Windows reference validation or whole-game proof is supplied.

The source implements the high-level state mapping, not an x86 ABI bridge. ECX mapping, stack cleanup, nonvolatile registers, DF and caller-dependent volatile-register relations require separate bridge validation.
Concurrency, MMIO, faults, null objects, exceptions, wrapping guest addresses and complete class layout remain excluded. Finite corpus agreement does not establish exhaustive domain coverage.
Review used only supplied material and reported verified bindings; hashes, binaries and omitted full observation files were not independently inspected.
review.summary: Approve the scoped source package. Its return bits, sentinel ordering and memory effects agree with the recorded instruction evidence, with defined C++ semantics and supporting bound execution reports.

integration_transition.change: Only the three package function statuses change from contracted to implemented. All identity, ABI, source, contract and backend fields remain identical.

scope: Independent text-only source review after automatic deterministic gates. Final checkout validation is recorded separately.
